text.arabic_uthmani: يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَٰرِيبَ وَتَمَٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍۢ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍۢ رَّاسِيَٰتٍ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًۭا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ

words.gloss_range: ongoing produced work by the resumed plural workforce, with moral-work resonance prepared for the later command
words.root_gloss_range: purposeful work, deed, and fabrication; here the active branch is concrete production that also prepares accountable action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later second-person plural imperative that turns work into commanded gratitude

words.prose: {{ar:يَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalūna}}) resumes the plural workforce from the previous ayah and makes their service ongoing rather than a one-time marvel. The Form I verb presents them as direct workers whose labor turns authorization into visible artifacts. Because the same work-root returns in {{ar:ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:iʿmalū}}), the verse lets crafted output lean toward moral accountability: work done for Sulayman will become work demanded as gratitude.

topics.headline: ongoing resumed workforce
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the artifact list comes from sustained supervised labor, not from a single isolated wonder.
topics.reason: The imperfect 3MP verb carries the prior jinn workforce forward and Form I keeps them as direct workers.

topics.headline: work made inspectable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees granted authority becoming visible as crafted output while still sounding near deed-language.
topics.reason: The root supports both fabrication and accountable deed, and the local inventory selects the production side while preserving the moral resonance.

topics.headline: narrative work before commanded work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears active labor before the object field opens, then recognizes the same root when the address turns into obligation.
topics.reason: The verb precedes the open object and later repeats as the imperative to David's house.

words.gloss_range: benefactive phrase with a definite 3MS beneficiary, oriented to Sulayman without making him the maker
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) orients the production toward a definite beneficiary supplied from the previous ayah: Sulayman. The prefixed lām separates recipient from maker, so the jinn remain the grammatical workers while the products are for him. Its early position places benefited authority before the open object field expands.

topics.headline: beneficiary before inventory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes Solomon as the recipient of production, not the manual producer of it.
topics.reason: The preposition plus suffix attaches to the making verb as a benefactive phrase and the suffix resolves across the boundary to Sulayman.

words.gloss_range: relative object that opens the production field under will before the list specifies examples

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following preposition that specifies the open relative object through the artifact list

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the relative object shared by the making verb and the willing clause. It does not ask what is made; it opens a broad slot for whatever Sulayman wills. The following {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) and artifact list specify that slot without exhausting the possibility opened by the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: object governed by will
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that production is defined by selected will before any artifact is named.
topics.reason: The particle functions as relative object of the making clause and as the governed content of the willing clause.

topics.headline: wide slot before examples
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the verse stage vast possibility before narrowing into concrete examples.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun opens the object field and the later explicative list narrows it as representative specification.

words.gloss_range: ongoing volitional selection inside the relative clause, not independent creative sovereignty
words.root_gloss_range: will, thingness, and selection; here the active sense is specifying what is to be made
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) keeps specification active inside the relative clause: the object is what Sulayman wills, not a closed past list. The root joins will to determinate thingness, so preference becomes a production target. Yet the simple Form I and the surrounding service frame keep making assigned to the workers and keep Sulayman's will within granted authority; same-surah will-and-measure echoes (34:9, 34:36, 34:39) and the thinghood contrast at 36:82 sharpen that limit rather than making this local will divine.

topics.headline: will selects objects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the inventory as the manifestation of directed choice rather than a random catalog.
topics.reason: The imperfect Form I verb governs the relative object and the list appears after that design authority is established.

topics.headline: will under granted authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Solomon's will has real design force while remaining bounded by the prior permission frame.
topics.reason: Cross-surah and same-surah will language (34:9, 34:36, 34:39; 36:82) can frame the scene, but local grammar keeps this verb as human specification within granted service.

words.gloss_range: explicative or partitive preposition specifying the open object through a coordinated inventory

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative object whose wide slot is specified by this preposition
later partitive preposition selecting the rare grateful subset from servants

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) turns the wide object opened by {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) into named artifact classes. One preposition governs the coordinated inventory, so the listed spaces, images, basins, and cauldrons remain examples within one object field. Its first use also prepares the later partitive {{ar:مِّنْ}} ({{tr:min}}): abundance is specified from objects, then scarcity is selected from servants.

topics.headline: open object specified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices syntax narrowing possibility into visible kinds without making them a separate object.
topics.reason: The preposition introduces the coordinated list as specification of the relative object.

topics.headline: first min before second min
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same small preposition framing abundant products first and rare responders later.
topics.reason: The first preposition opens artifact specification and the second later introduces the servant subset.

words.gloss_range: plural protected or elevated architectural spaces at the head of the inventory
words.root_gloss_range: conflict, protected exposure, stripping, and elevated/chamber senses; here selected as protected architectural space

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: list-governing preposition under which the plural architectural noun is specified

words.prose: {{ar:مَّحَٰرِيبَ}} ({{tr:maḥārība}}) begins the inventory at the scale of protected, set-apart architecture. Its diptote broken plural keeps the item as a class of spaces under {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), not one chamber. The war-root background contributes defended prominence, while the place-noun plural turns one protected locus into a program of built spaces; the secluded provision-space at 3:37 is a useful contrast, but here the plural belongs to royal manufactured abundance.

topics.headline: plural place-program
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the list open with a public architectural category rather than a single sacred chamber.
topics.reason: The broken plural and place-form evidence support an architectural class under the list-governing preposition.

topics.headline: fortified prominence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the first artifact as protected and set apart, not merely large.
topics.reason: The root field allows conflict and defended-exposure imagery, locally narrowed to protected architectural prominence.

topics.headline: seclusion contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 3:37's singular protected provision-space with this ayah's multiplied royal spaces.
topics.reason: The 3:37 parallel is valid as contrast, but it does not override the local plural inventory sense.

words.gloss_range: coordinate conjunction sustaining the additive inventory without hierarchy
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the list additive. It joins the images to the protected spaces as a parallel artifact type under the same governing inventory, so representation is not a subordinate explanation of architecture but another domain of crafted output.

topics.headline: parallel second item
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears architecture and representation accumulate side by side rather than in a hierarchy.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the next noun inside the same list governed by the earlier preposition.

words.gloss_range: crafted plural representations, making likeness public and material inside the artifact list
words.root_gloss_range: likeness, comparison, example, and representation; here the concrete representation branch is active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later comparison particle that makes likeness function syntactically

words.prose: {{ar:تَمَٰثِيلَ}} ({{tr:tamāthīla}}) keeps the same list behavior as the preceding plural and shifts the inventory from spaces to public likenesses. The root normally moves through comparison and example, but here likeness is manufactured as visible objects. That makes the later comparison particle {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) feel deliberate: likeness appears first as a crafted noun and then as the grammar that measures the basins; 19:17 supplies a contrast where likeness appears as manifestation, while 34:13 makes likeness an artifact.

topics.headline: same inventory grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears images bound to the same specified production set as the architectural spaces.
topics.reason: The diptote plural behaves like the preceding list item under the same governing preposition.

topics.headline: likeness made object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a common comparison-root becoming concrete public craft.
topics.reason: The local noun selects the concrete representation branch while retaining the root's likeness and comparison pressure.

topics.headline: likeness as object and grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah repeat likeness as manufactured representation and then as a measuring particle.
topics.reason: The following comparison particle and the 19:17 contrast preserve the likeness motif without changing the local concrete noun.

words.gloss_range: coordinate conjunction moving the inventory from display objects into provisioning vessels

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following coordinated basins that shift the inventory toward provision

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) passes the same list governance to {{ar:جِفَانٍۢ}} ({{tr:jifānin}}). Its payoff is not just another item: the inventory turns from spaces and images toward vessels of provision while keeping the same additive rhythm.

topics.headline: from display to provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the catalog widen from public display into communal sustenance.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the bowls under the same inventory while the semantic domain shifts toward feeding vessels.

words.gloss_range: large serving basins whose scale is completed by the following reservoir simile
words.root_gloss_range: containment surfaces such as eyelid, sheath, and bowl; here communal serving-basin capacity is active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following reservoir simile that supplies the basins with scale

words.prose: {{ar:جِفَانٍۢ}} ({{tr:jifānin}}) names plural serving basins, but the word waits for the following simile to disclose their scale. The containment field behind the root turns the bowls into communal holding capacity, not ornamental tableware. Their rarity and force depend on {{ar:كَٱلْجَوَابِ}} ({{tr:ka-l-jawābi}}), which revises ordinary bowls upward toward reservoirs; the sound of nunation moving into the comparison supports the join, though it only adds recitational texture.

topics.headline: bowls scaled by comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits with the noun until the simile expands its ordinary vessel sense into reservoir scale.
topics.reason: The noun remains the list item while the following comparative phrase supplies extraordinary scale.

topics.headline: communal holding capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the vessels as infrastructure for feeding groups, not just impressive containers.
topics.reason: The local plural selects the large-bowl sense from a containment field and the context of provision gives it communal force.

topics.headline: sound binds vessel to scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a compact recitational transition from the basin noun into the scale comparison.
topics.reason: The sound observation supports texture but does not alter the syntactic relation or lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: comparative particle importing reservoir scale into the basin noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier noun where likeness appears as a crafted artifact

words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) is not another artifact. It governs the reservoir term and measures the basins by imported scale and function. After {{ar:تَمَٰثِيلَ}} ({{tr:tamāthīla}}) has made likeness into crafted objects, this particle makes likeness a grammatical instrument.

topics.headline: comparison measures scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the comparison as scale measurement rather than decorative analogy.
topics.reason: The kāf phrase modifies the basin noun by importing the comparison term's salient property.

topics.headline: likeness becomes syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah repeat likeness once as an object and then as the grammar of comparison.
topics.reason: The particle-level comparison follows the noun for manufactured likenesses and continues the same cognitive operation in syntax.

words.gloss_range: definite reservoir-like collectors used as the scale term for the basins
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, collecting, bringing into a center, and selected gathering; here collected reservoir volume is active
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَوَابِ}} ({{tr:al-jawābi}}) supplies a recognizable reservoir class for the simile. The root's gathering field makes the comparison about collected volume, not shape alone, so the bowls are reimagined as storage-scale provision. Variant final-yā realization keeps the reservoir plural transparent without changing the local comparison, and the broader selected-gathering use at 22:78 remains a background contrast rather than the active sense here.

topics.headline: definite reservoir comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader revises the heard bowls upward into recognizable reservoir-scale containers.
topics.reason: The definite plural after the comparison particle names the comparison class and the root supports gathering into held volume.

topics.headline: variant sound preserves sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational texture may change the final yā release while the reservoir comparison stays fixed.
topics.reason: The variants affect final sound and transparency, not the root, definiteness, or comparison relation.

topics.headline: gathering beyond reservoirs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear resource concentration near the gratitude demand while keeping reservoir volume as the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The selected-gathering sense seen at 22:78 is related but does not govern the local noun under the simile.

words.gloss_range: final coordinate conjunction introducing the cauldrons plus their stabilizing adjective as one inventory unit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following noun-plus-adjective unit that closes the artifact inventory

words.prose: The final inventory {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces not just another noun but the unit {{ar:قُدُورٍۢ رَّاسِيَٰتٍ}} ({{tr:qudūrin rāsiyātin}}). It closes the catalog with cauldrons whose fixedness is built into the item, preparing the turn from artifact description to command.

topics.headline: final coordinated unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the list close on a noun-plus-adjective unit rather than a loose extra item.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the cauldrons and their adjective as the closing artifact item.

words.gloss_range: plural cauldrons as measured capacity, directly modified into fixed infrastructure
words.root_gloss_range: measure, apportioning, capacity, power, and cooking vessel; here the material vessel of measured capacity is active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following adjective that fixes the cauldrons as installed equipment

words.prose: {{ar:قُدُورٍۢ}} ({{tr:qudūrin}}) remains a coordinated list item, but its adjective prevents generic cookware from being heard. These are vessels of measured capacity, where provision is apportioned and transformed, and {{ar:رَّاسِيَٰتٍ}} ({{tr:rāsiyātin}}) turns them into installed infrastructure. The broader measure-root can recall divine apportioning, including 65:3 and same-surah measure language (34:11, 34:18, 34:36, 34:39), but the local payoff is concrete cauldrons whose capacity is fixed in place.

topics.headline: measured vessels fixed by adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the cauldrons as provisioning infrastructure, not movable cookware or ornament.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated under the list and directly modified by the feminine plural participle.

topics.headline: capacity made material
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a measure-and-capacity root becoming a physical vessel for usable provision.
topics.reason: The local noun selects the cooking-vessel sense while preserving the root's capacity and measure pressure.

topics.headline: measure network in background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place the cauldrons near broader measure and provision discourse without turning them into an abstract doctrine.
topics.reason: Same-surah measure language (34:11, 34:18, 34:36, 34:39) and 65:3 are relevant background, but local grammar and noun sense remain material cauldrons.

words.gloss_range: feminine plural active participle describing the cauldrons as fixed or anchored
words.root_gloss_range: anchoring, settling, firmness, and mountain stability; here fixed installed state is active
words.prose: {{ar:رَّاسِيَٰتٍ}} ({{tr:rāsiyātin}}) agrees with the cauldrons and makes fixedness their continuing state. The active participle does not describe a momentary placement; it characterizes installed provision. The root's mountain-anchoring field, seen in 79:32, is scaled down into palace equipment, while the nunation-to-rāʾ sound link only reinforces the phrase's texture.

topics.headline: fixedness belongs to cauldrons
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees stability as a property of the cauldrons themselves, not a loose descriptive afterthought.
topics.reason: Agreement binds the adjective to the cauldrons and the active participle gives an enduring state.

topics.headline: mountain stability miniaturized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears cosmic anchoring language reduced to fixed provisioning equipment.
topics.reason: The mountain-root field and 79:32 support the imagery, while local adjective agreement keeps the sense fixed to cauldrons.

topics.headline: sound binds adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the phrase roll into the adjective, reinforcing the lexical bond without changing the parse.
topics.reason: The sound observation is textural and subordinate to the syntactically forced adjective relation.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperative turning narrated production into obligated grateful action
words.root_gloss_range: work, deed, fabrication, and enacted conduct; here direct commanded action is active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accusative verbal noun naming gratitude as the mode and purpose of the commanded work
earlier third-person work verb echoed by this imperative

words.prose: {{ar:ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:iʿmalū}}) breaks the description into command. The object list drops away and work must now be shaped by {{ar:شُكْرًۭا}} ({{tr:shukran}}), so gratitude is practical, embodied action rather than speech alone. The move from third-person {{ar:يَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿmalūna}}) to second-person command turns spectatorship into accountability, and deed-language at 2:25 plus the later explicit gratitude command at 34:15 confirm the forward test without changing this local imperative.

topics.headline: work becomes command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verse converting manufactured abundance into a direct demand for grateful action.
topics.reason: The imperative addresses a plural subject and the following accusative gratitude word supplies the commanded mode or purpose.

topics.headline: third person to second person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same work-root move from labor done for Solomon to work demanded from David's house.
topics.reason: The repeated root and person shift form a local contrast between narrated production and direct obligation.

topics.headline: later gratitude command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place the command near wider deed-language and the 34:15 gratitude test while keeping this word's force as direct work.
topics.reason: The 2:25 deed formula and 34:15 gratitude command illuminate the arc but do not replace the local imperative.

words.gloss_range: compact vocative construct naming David's house as the corporate addressee
words.root_gloss_range: household, people, affiliation, source, and return; here corporate house or following is active
words.prose: {{ar:ءَالَ}} ({{tr:āla}}) names the commanded addressee as a house or following, not a single private individual. The vocative yā is absent, so the address is compact and urgent, and the command has already struck before the privileged house is named. Chosen-house language such as 3:33 helps the reader feel the status, but here that status is reframed as responsibility.

topics.headline: vocative house after command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears obligation arrive before the house can rest in its status.
topics.reason: The construct functions as vocative addressee after the imperative, with no overt vocative particle.

topics.headline: legacy community bound to duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices gratitude assigned to a corporate legacy community, not only to an individual.
topics.reason: The noun can mark household or affiliates, and the construct binds that group to David's name.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name completing the construct and anchoring the household in David's remembered favor
words.prose: {{ar:دَاوُۥدَ}} ({{tr:Dāwūda}}) completes the construct as the named source of the addressed house. As a foreign proper name it contributes identity and scriptural memory, not Arabic root play. Because 34:10 has already named favor given to David, the command lands on a living household whose ancestor and gift-history are named only after the house has been addressed.

topics.headline: identity not etymology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the word as a named ancestor anchoring the construct, not as a field for invented root semantics.
topics.reason: The proper name completes the construct despite limited inflection and is not productive Arabic derivation.

topics.headline: remembered favor frames duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the gratitude command as response to remembered prophetic favor, not abstract ethics.
topics.reason: The named ancestor recalls the favor sequence of 34:10 and anchors the household command historically.

topics.headline: community named before source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the responsibility fall on the house before the ancestor is named.
topics.reason: The construct presents the household term first and the proper name second.

words.gloss_range: accusative verbal noun specifying work as gratitude, by manner and purpose
words.root_gloss_range: gratitude as visible return for benefit, thriving response, acknowledgment, and thankful conduct

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperative whose action is specified by gratitude
final intensive identity formed from the same gratitude root

words.prose: {{ar:شُكْرًۭا}} ({{tr:shukran}}) tells how and why the commanded work is to be done. Because it is not cognate with {{ar:ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:iʿmalū}}), its accusative force most strongly makes gratitude the mode and purpose of action. The root makes received benefit visible in response, so after visible abundance the house must make favor show in conduct. The same root later closes as {{ar:ٱلشَّكُورُ}} ({{tr:al-shakūru}}), and 14:7 and 34:15 belong to the wider gratitude arc, but here the word is the demanded practice.

topics.headline: work as and for gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees gratitude shaping the commanded work itself, not merely naming a separate object.
topics.reason: The accusative verbal noun after a noncognate imperative licenses manner and purpose readings.

topics.headline: benefit made visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gratitude is outward response to received favor, not private appreciation.
topics.reason: The root field supports visible thankful response, and the preceding artifact scene makes the received benefit public.

topics.headline: act before identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks commanded gratitude as practice before the ayah judges the rare grateful character.
topics.reason: The verbal noun precedes the final intensive identity, and same-surah gratitude language at 34:15 and 34:19 extends the test.

words.gloss_range: resumptive or circumstantial conjunction pivoting from command to scarcity judgment
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns from demanded gratitude to evaluation without needing an overt adversative particle. It can resume the discourse or color the command circumstantially, but the next word supplies the shock: the command does not sound easy, because grateful servants are immediately judged few.

topics.headline: command to assessment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the command immediately sobered by a scarcity judgment.
topics.reason: The conjunction opens the final predicative clause and the contrast is carried by the scarcity predicate that follows.

words.gloss_range: fronted predicate of fewness, diagnosing low prevalence rather than low value
words.root_gloss_range: fewness, small quantity, scarcity, and slightness; here prevalence scarcity is active
words.prose: {{ar:قَلِيلٌۭ}} ({{tr:qalīlun}}) is the first word of the closing judgment, so scarcity arrives before the rare type is named. As a bare predicate in a terse nominal clause, it governs the whole close rather than merely modifying servants. The root measures prevalence, not the value of gratitude: after abundant spaces, images, basins, and cauldrons, the truly grateful responder is few. The echo at 34:16 keeps this scarcity inside Sabaʾ's favor-response sequence.

topics.headline: scarcity heard first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears scarcity govern the closing clause before servant belonging or grateful identity appears.
topics.reason: The indefinite adjective is a fronted nominative predicate before the delayed subject.

topics.headline: few responders after abundance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a diagnosis of rare grateful people, not a diminishment of gratitude itself.
topics.reason: The root and clause context measure the population of gratitude after the artifact abundance.

topics.headline: same-surah scarcity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place this scarcity beside covenant-failure at 2:83 and Sabaʾ favor-response scarcity at 34:16 without losing the local predicate force.
topics.reason: The 2:83 comparison and 34:16 echo are concrete parallels for scarcity after favor, while the local clause supplies the governing judgment.

words.gloss_range: partitive preposition selecting the few grateful from within God's servants
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the scarcity internal. The few are selected from within God's servants, not contrasted with an outside group. This second {{ar:مِّنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) reverses the first one's abundance logic: the earlier preposition opened artifact kinds, while this one narrows the servant class to rare responders.

topics.headline: few within servants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the severity of rarity inside the class of God's own servants.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase completes the scarcity predicate by naming the class from which the few are drawn.

topics.headline: abundance to rarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah's movement from abundant outputs to scarce responders through repeated prepositional framing.
topics.reason: The first preposition specifies product classes and this one selects a rare subset of servants.

words.gloss_range: plural servants in construct with the divine first-person suffix, inside the partitive scarcity phrase
words.root_gloss_range: servitude, worship, dependence, bonded service, and marked subjection; here servant/worshipper belonging is active
words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادِىَ}} ({{tr:ʿibādiya}}) carries both partitive grammar and possession: the servants are the class from which the few are drawn and they belong to the divine speaker. That makes the scarcity more severe, not softer. The root binds service, worship, and dependence, so gratitude's rarity is a failure inside acknowledged servanthood; 51:56 and 34:39 can frame the servant-status thread. The final-yā variants affect recitational release, not the possessive relation.

topics.headline: possessed servant class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rarity is stated within those belonging to God, not outside that relation.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the partitive preposition while forming construct with the first-person suffix.

topics.headline: service heightens gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears gratitude's rarity as a failure within service, worship, and dependence.
topics.reason: The root field supports servant/worshipper dependence, and concrete references at 51:56 and 34:39 extend the servant-status thread.

topics.headline: variant release not possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register recitational texture while keeping the divine possessive relation stable.
topics.reason: The variants change final yā realization before the final word but preserve possession and partitive force.

words.gloss_range: definite singular intensive naming the rare grateful type as delayed subject
words.root_gloss_range: gratitude as visible, repeated, abundant response to received favor; here the intensive stable character is active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier commanded gratitude practice echoed by the final intensive identity

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّكُورُ}} ({{tr:al-shakūru}}) is delayed until scarcity and servant belonging have already framed it. The definite singular names a type, not one counted individual, and the faʿūl pattern makes gratitude durable and abundant rather than occasional thanks. The root echo from {{ar:شُكْرًۭا}} ({{tr:shukran}}) to {{ar:ٱلشَّكُورُ}} ({{tr:al-shakūru}}) measures commanded act against rare character; 17:3 gives Noah as a grateful servant, and 34:15 continues the test, but this final word seals the scarcity judgment.

topics.headline: rare type named last
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final identity arrive only after scarcity and servant class have prepared it.
topics.reason: The definite singular intensive is the delayed nominative subject of the scarcity clause.

topics.headline: stable abundant gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the rare settled grateful type from a single act or statement of thanks.
topics.reason: The faʿūl pattern intensifies the root into habitual and abundant responsiveness.

topics.headline: commanded act becomes rare identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah turn visible abundance into a moral reversal: gratitude is commanded, but the stable grateful servant is rare.
topics.reason: The root echo links the commanded verbal noun to the final intensive identity, with 17:3 and 34:15 strengthening the servant-gratitude arc.

baseline_models.mechanism: The wished-for thing is specified at one pole and delegated labor realizes it at the other, forming an authorization-to-production chain.

activation_trace.role: Putting another to work and requesting labor supplies the executing link that turns specification into output.
Will attached to bringing about or attaining a thing supplies the specifying and initiating link.

changed_reading.before: They make whatever the beneficiary wants.
changed_reading.after: The clause maps how authorized will becomes determinate material output through delegated work.

baseline_models.mechanism: Food vessels scaled by reservoirs and cooking pots made stationary describe durable, high-throughput provisioning rather than isolated luxury utensils.

activation_trace.role: The food-platter branch supplies the direct feeding function of the large vessels.
The gathered-water basin supplies the comparison's reservoir scale and collective capacity.
The cooking-pot branch supplies transformation of provision by sustained preparation.
Fixity and firm establishment turn the vessels into installed infrastructure.

changed_reading.before: The verse inventories magnificent bowls and cauldrons.
changed_reading.after: The vessels form a stationary provisioning plant able to gather, cook, and distribute at communal scale.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: اعْمَلُوا آلَ دَاوُودَ شُكْرًا وَقَلِيلٌ مِنْ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُورُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative makes gratitude an intended practice whose effect must appear in service; the closing scarcity diagnoses how rarely that productive response is realized.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies gratitude's enacted rather than merely verbal mode.
Recognition and visible acknowledgment of benefaction supply the aim of the commanded work.
A little input showing a marked effect makes grateful service legible by yield, not volume alone.
Numerical scarcity marks realized gratitude as an uncommon human capacity.
Humble obedient service locates gratitude within the servant's lived posture.

changed_reading.before: The household is told to say thanks for its gifts.
changed_reading.after: The household must convert received capacity into visible, intentional service, a conversion achieved by few.

baseline_models.mechanism: The vocative recruits a house, its dependents, and its successors as a continuing body that holds and performs an office of grateful work.

activation_trace.role: Those who return to a man and to whom he returns supply household, dependents, and followers as the corporate addressee.
Undertaking and administering an office supplies the household's stewardship function.
Holding responsibility for assigned work turns lineage into an accountable institution.

changed_reading.before: The family of David receives a collective exhortation.
changed_reading.after: Belonging to David's house is enacted as succession in a governed office of grateful production.

baseline_models.mechanism: A fabricated likeness can preserve a model before viewers and thereby participate in public memory or exemplarity, not only ornament.

activation_trace.role: The fashioned image supplies the direct representational object.
The exemplar as a lesson or sign supplies a possible mnemonic function for the image.

changed_reading.before: The تماثيل are decorative images among royal works.
changed_reading.after: They may also be durable represented exemplars that organize what a community sees and remembers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding armor command defines good making as calibrated linkage, complete coverage, and fitness; that craft ethic transfers to the focus verse's large installed works.

activation_trace.role: The cooking vessel supplies the focus artifact whose capacity and construction are being reevaluated.
Deliberate measuring and fitting supply the design discipline behind production.
Perforating and joining rings makes measured interconnection materially concrete.
Suitability for purpose supplies the moral and functional criterion for finished work.

structural_cues: 34:11 repeats the work imperative immediately before 34:13 and places it around measured armor-making.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement, linked construction, and fit work; I infer that the same craft ethic governs the focus inventory, while a live alternative confines those criteria to armor alone.

changed_reading.before: Scale and splendor are the salient qualities of the focus objects.
changed_reading.after: Their legitimate splendor depends on measured fit, connected construction, and fitness for purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: David's setting makes solid mountains responsive and hard iron pliable, so household work appears within a wider choreography of returning voices and transformable matter.

activation_trace.role: Intentional making supplies the human side of the responsive material system.
The solid elevated mass supplies matter normally resistant to human-scale response.
Returning to a source supplies reciprocal response rather than one-way extraction.
Softness opposing rough hardness supplies material tractability.
Iron's resistant solidity supplies the hard material whose changed condition enables craft.

structural_cues: 34:10 names David and places responsive mountain, bird, and iron immediately before the work sequence of 34:11-13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return and softened hardness; I infer a reciprocal ecology of craft, while the live alternative treats these as separate favors with no general model of making.

changed_reading.before: The household imposes designs upon passive materials.
changed_reading.after: Its grateful making participates in a field where voices return and resistant matter is made responsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Molten material and hidden workers execute a command only by permission, while later even an atom's weight cannot be independently owned; productive authority is therefore delegated and bounded rather than self-grounding.

activation_trace.role: Delegated labor supplies the focus production relation that requires an authority model.
Effective willing supplies the apparent initiating power whose limits context reveals.
Molten copper supplies the material stream converted into works.
Hidden beings supply the otherwise unnamed workforce of the focus opening.
Permission supplies the higher authorization under which the labor system operates.
Binding command supplies governance and the possibility of accountable deviation.
Exact weight supplies the scale at which claims of autonomous power are tested.
The minute dispersed particle supplies the smallest test case for possession.
Possession and disposal rights supply the ownership claim that the context denies to rival powers.

structural_cues: 34:12 immediately supplies the antecedent and governance conditions for يَعْمَلُونَ in 34:13.
34:22 denies independent ownership, partnership, or support at even the smallest material scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission, command, material flow, and denied atom-scale ownership; I infer a distinction between operational control and ultimate title, while an alternative reads the later denial only as unrelated polemic against false gods.

changed_reading.before: Royal will itself seems sufficient to explain the magnificent output.
changed_reading.after: The output manifests delegated operational authority under permission, not autonomous ownership or unlimited sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The labor order can continue after its ruler has lost life because workers misread a decaying support; when that support is consumed, collapse exposes the ignorance beneath apparent continuity.

activation_trace.role: Firm fixity supplies the focus image of durable installed order.
Ongoing delegated work supplies the institutional activity that can outlast informed command.
Loss of life and power removes the actual directing agent while its posture remains.
Consumption as gradual corruption supplies the hidden erosion of the support.
Noisy disordered falling supplies the abrupt visible failure of apparent stability.
Disclosure after concealment supplies the epistemic result of collapse.
What is hidden from sight supplies the workforce's mistaken information environment.

structural_cues: 34:14 directly follows the fixed vessels and labor command with death, continued labor, decay, and collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an apparently standing ruler, hidden decay, laboring workers, and collapse; I infer that focus fixity is institutionally contingent, while an alternative limits the point to the workers' ignorance of the unseen.

changed_reading.before: The stationary pots and continuing workforce display unqualified durability and mastery.
changed_reading.after: Their stability is a maintained achievement resting on knowable supports; apparent continuity can conceal lost authority and advancing decay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reservoir-scale bowls and fixed pots become nodes in a provision network whose water barriers, measured routes, and settlements can sustain circulation or reverse into flood, substitution, and fragmentation.

activation_trace.role: A large basin of gathered water supplies storage capacity at the center of the network.
Fixed installation supplies stable provisioning nodes.
The cooking vessel supplies bounded capacity for transforming distributed provision.
Nourishing sustenance supplies what the material system is meant to circulate.
Running floodwater supplies the destructive reversal of gathered and governed flow.
An embankment holding back floodwater supplies the hidden control structure behind abundance.
One thing replacing another supplies the conversion of productive abundance into degraded yield.
Measured planning supplies calibrated travel intervals as another form of provisioning capacity.
Tearing into separated pieces supplies network failure at the social and spatial level.

structural_cues: 34:15-19 moves from eating provision and gratitude through dam failure to measured settlements and finally torn routes and people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vessels, stored and released flow, measured travel, and fragmentation; I infer one coupled provisioning network, while a live alternative keeps kitchen, irrigation, and travel as separate domains.

changed_reading.before: The bowls and pots are palace-scale signs of abundance.
changed_reading.after: They are infrastructural nodes in a coupled food, water, and mobility system whose benefits depend on maintained relations and can catastrophically reverse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from materially little produce after failed gratitude to the patient-grateful reader of rupture and then to an excepted group; the focus's few become a resilient remainder, not only a disappointing statistic.

activation_trace.role: Scarcity supplies the focus's small number of fully grateful servants.
A little input producing visible effect supplies a positive capacity latent within smallness.
Material paucity supplies the degraded landscape's literal counterpart to the focus's human fewness.
Holding oneself through distress supplies the endurance by which gratitude survives loss.
Acknowledgment after fragmentation supplies gratitude that is not limited to prosperity.
A distinct separated group supplies the social shape of the exceptional remainder.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats قليل and شكور around ecological and social rupture, then marks an excepted group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical smallness, patient gratitude, and an exception group; I infer a resilient-remnant model, while an alternative treats each recurrence as an independent observation.

changed_reading.before: Few servants are grateful, a flat report of rarity.
changed_reading.after: The few are also the small but effect-bearing remainder able to read loss, endure it, and keep gratitude operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: A community can be torn apart and then made into transmitted accounts and signs; against that sequence, fashioned likenesses can serve as externalized public memory of patterns and consequences.

activation_trace.role: The fashioned image supplies the durable representational medium.
The exemplar as lesson supplies the image's possible warning function.
Becoming an account told by people supplies conversion of a vanished society into memory.
Tearing and dispersal supplies the historical rupture that memory preserves.
A visible distinguishing sign supplies the interpretive status of the remembered event.

structural_cues: 34:19 explicitly moves from making a people into accounts and fragments to calling the result signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies images, cautionary accounts, fragments, and signs; I infer that representation can externalize communal memory, while the live alternative leaves the تماثيل as non-didactic decoration.

changed_reading.before: The statues are self-contained products of skilled manufacture.
changed_reading.after: They may participate in a memory system that makes absent persons or broken histories present as exemplars.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later commanders and subordinates exchange blame, yet recompense remains tied to work; the focus's asymmetric production chain is therefore morally legible only when command, compliance, and result remain under audit.

activation_trace.role: Putting others to work supplies the asymmetric labor relation whose moral quality context tests.
Holding office supplies accountable governance rather than mere household prestige.
Lack of power supplies the subordinate party's constrained position.
Self-magnifying superiority supplies the commanding party's distorted authority.
Binding command supplies the causal claim by which subordinates assign blame upward.
A collar that binds the body supplies the end-state of coercive hierarchy.
Corresponding recompense supplies the audit that returns outcomes to action.
Intentional action supplies the final unit of responsibility despite exchanged blame.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 stages a dispute between the weakened and the self-exalting and closes by tying recompense to what they worked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later abusive command hierarchy and action-based recompense; I infer an ethical audit of all delegated work, not an identity between Solomon's workforce and that condemned hierarchy. The live alternative treats the scenes as unrelated.

changed_reading.before: Successful output validates the command structure that produced it.
changed_reading.after: Output alone does not validate hierarchy; grateful purpose, authorized command, and each participant's action remain independently accountable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same cluster of will, servants, and q-d-r is placed inside provision that expands or contracts and is renewed through spending; a vessel's capacity is real, but neither its filling nor its continuity is self-generated.

activation_trace.role: Will attached to a thing supplies the focus's effective specification of output.
The pot supplies a bounded material capacity whose filling is at issue.
Expansion and increase supply one direction of provision's variable scale.
Allocated gift supplies the content whose source exceeds the vessel and household.
Will bound to a thing links the allocation clause back to the focus production clause.
Servant relation places variable provision within the same human field as the focus's grateful servants.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the opposite of expansion and exposes capacity limits.
Outgoing expenditure supplies circulation rather than hoarding as the operative response to provision.
A successor taking the place of what departed supplies renewal after outflow.

structural_cues: 34:36 and 34:39 repeat يَشَاءُ and يَقْدِرُ around provision; 34:39 also repeats عِبَادِ and شَيْءٍ from the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence and q-d-r's pot, planning, and constriction branches; I infer a capacity-allocation metaphor, while the live alternative treats the noun and verb senses as rhetorically unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The enormous vessels imply secure and self-evident abundance.
changed_reading.after: They display receiving capacity, while actual provision remains variable and is sustained through grateful outflow and replacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, wealth does not bring anyone near, whereas faithful fit work does and receives upper rooms; architectural elevation in the focus is thus subordinated to enacted moral proximity.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work links the focus's built environment to the later criterion of nearness.
Approach to God supplies the non-material proximity denied to wealth and descendants.
Intentional action supplies the means paired with faith rather than possessions.
Fitness and suitability supply the qualifying quality of the work.
The upper chamber supplies architectural elevation as result and image, not the cause of nearness.

structural_cues: 34:37 juxtaposes failed material means of approach, fit work, doubled recompense, and secure upper chambers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus architecture and later ethical nearness with upper rooms; I infer a critique of treating built height as spiritual rank, while an alternative sees only two unrelated architectural settings.

changed_reading.before: Monumental chambers can appear to embody privileged nearness by themselves.
changed_reading.after: Built elevation is an image or consequence of nearness; fit grateful work, not possession of architecture, is the operative approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden agents can perform delegated work yet later become objects of mistaken worship; the focus's closing 'My servants' distinguishes service within an order from worship directed toward an intermediary.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience and worship supply the focus term whose object must be distinguished.
Delegated work supplies a service relation that need not make the worker or manager divine.
Hidden beings supply the delegated workers immediately before the focus.
Worship directed to an alleged intermediary supplies the relation under examination.
True protecting allegiance supplies the angels' redirection of loyalty away from themselves.
Misdirected obedient worship supplies the error that mere hidden agency can invite.
The hidden beings supply the mistaken object of worship in the later scene.

structural_cues: The surah first presents jinn as workers under permission and later presents worship of jinn as a disowned relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same agent category in labor and worship settings; I infer a warning against deifying delegated agency, while a live alternative distinguishes the two groups without cross-reference.

changed_reading.before: Service, labor, and worship can blur into one vertical relation around spectacular power.
changed_reading.after: Delegated service is legitimate only while ultimate worship and protecting allegiance remain directed beyond every intermediary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later refusal to ask people for payment sharpens 'work as gratitude' into a response to gift rather than a bargain that purchases or repays the giver.

activation_trace.role: Wages and worker sustenance supply the transactional possibility against which grateful work is distinguished.
Acknowledgment of benefaction supplies the non-purchase logic of the imperative.
Asking or requesting supplies the denied demand for payment from the audience.
Compensation for work supplies the explicit wage category redirected away from the hearers.

structural_cues: 34:47 repeats أجر around a denial of requested payment and assigns recompense elsewhere.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prophetic no-fee declaration and the focus's gratitude-work; I infer a shared non-mercenary ethical layer, while the alternative keeps the declaration separate. This does not imply that ordinary material workers should go unpaid.

changed_reading.before: The commanded work could sound like repayment that settles a debt for benefits received.
changed_reading.after: Grateful work acknowledges an unpriced gift and cannot purchase, equal, or discharge its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus opens a short path from will through authorized work to attained things; the ending closes access, placing distance and a barrier between people and appetite's object.

activation_trace.role: Will tied to attaining or bringing about a thing supplies the successful focus-side relation to an object.
Organized labor supplies the authorized means by which the focus-side object is reached.
Reaching by extending toward something supplies the access that has become impossible.
Distance opposing nearness supplies the spatialized failure of late access.
A separator placed between two sides supplies the final severing mechanism.
The self's pull toward a desired object supplies appetite without effective authorized means.

structural_cues: The focus links work to what is willed, whereas the surah's close links distance and a barrier to what is desired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a successful will-work-object chain and a failed appetite-access chain; I infer a deliberate reversal between authorized effective will and belated appetite, while an alternative reads the ending only as eschatological deprivation.

changed_reading.before: Whatever is willed appears immediately available to sufficient power and labor.
changed_reading.after: Effective willing depends on rightful authorization, means, and time; appetite alone can end separated from the very thing it seeks.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The q-l-l branch meaning a large jar is far from the surface sense 'few,' but it remains anchored in قَلِيل and is reinforced by the verse's huge food vessels and the sh-k-r image of little producing visible effect. Render only as lexical-material resonance, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جِفَانٍ كَالْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَاسِيَاتٍ ... وَقَلِيلٌ مِنْ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُورُ

activation_trace.role: The large-jar branch lets the closing numerical smallness resonate unexpectedly with the verse's oversized containers.
Little nourishment yielding a visible effect supplies the paradox that small count need not mean small capacity.
The large food vessel supplies the concrete container image against which the few servants are reread.

changed_reading.before: Fewness simply means an inadequate number of grateful servants.
changed_reading.after: The few may also be imagined as rare high-capacity vessels in whom a small input of gift becomes conspicuously fruitful.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The link crosses from the m-th-l branch of standing presence to a later command for people to stand in pairs and singly, so it is associative rather than syntactically asserted. It remains anchored in تَمَاثِيل and the precise standing/thinking sequence; prose should present it as a visual foil, not the statues' lexical definition.

activation_trace.role: Standing and appearing present supplies the posture latent beside the fashioned images.
The made likeness supplies the static represented body.
Bodily standing supplies the living counterpart to the fashioned standing form.
Pairing one with one supplies a relational arrangement for living reflection.
Standing alone supplies the complementary individual arrangement.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the capacity that distinguishes living figures from made likenesses.

changed_reading.before: The تماثيل are active craftsmanship resulting in passive standing images.
changed_reading.after: They can serve as a foil for living figures who must stand, relate or separate, and activate reflection rather than merely occupy form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The conflict echo in the h-r-b inventory is branch-distant from مَحَارِيب, and the armor-to-chains comparison spans separate scenes. It remains anchored in the focus root and the surah's repeated organized metalwork; render as a contained political shadow of craft, never as the direct meaning of محاريب.

activation_trace.role: War and enmity supply the distant conflict shadow carried by the architectural root inventory.
Organized delegated labor supplies the production capacity that can be morally directed in different ways.
Wide complete covering supplies protective armor as one output of disciplined craft.
The binding collar supplies coercive metalwork as the opposed political output.

changed_reading.before: The monumental workshop is morally characterized by technical magnificence alone.
changed_reading.after: Its production capacity carries a contained double potential: measured craft can cover and protect, while corrupted hierarchy can use material skill to bind.

strongest_changes: The focus inventory becomes calibrated craft whose legitimacy rests on fit, linkage, and moral purpose rather than scale alone.
Reservoir bowls and fixed pots expand into a coupled provisioning network vulnerable to failed water control, broken routes, and social fragmentation.
The next ayah turns apparent stability into a contingent achievement that can conceal dead authority, hidden decay, and uninformed labor.
Repeated will, q-d-r, provision, and spending separate receiving capacity from self-generated abundance.
The surah's ending reverses the focus's effective will-work-object chain into appetite blocked from its object.
summary.what_was_special: The trace repeatedly converts spectacular objects into relations: between will and permission, vessel and flow, command and accountability, household and succession, and small number and high visible yield.
remaining_uncertainties: How strongly the q-d-r recurrence licenses a deliberate pot, measure, and constriction resonance rather than a reader-built polysemy.
Whether the تماثيل carry mnemonic or exemplary force in this verse, or only become such through the later accounts-and-signs sequence.
How far the later blame dialogue should audit the focus labor hierarchy without assimilating legitimate delegated work to abusive command.
Whether the few-as-large-vessels and living-versus-fashioned-standing outliers are rhetorically active or only branch-supported exploratory echoes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Gratitude is labor that turns capacity into shared infrastructure.** `ع م ل/B002` is putting something to work, `ج ب ي/B002` gathering into a basin, `ر س و/B001` fixed anchoring, and `ش ك ر/B001` acknowledging favor through praise. The list moves from built spaces and figures to collecting basins and anchored pots, then converts the same verb from their manufacture to David’s household’s gratitude. Collection and anchoring make provision durable and distributable; gratitude names the human use of that durability. The packet supplies artifacts and imperative; I infer that making bounty serviceable is how thanks becomes work. The ayah reads gratitude as maintained material practice, not speech alone.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:15’s command to eat and give thanks and 34:19’s pairing of patience with gratitude broadened the built vessels into an ethics of maintaining provision across changing conditions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A containment system for turning flow into nourishment.** `ج ف ن B001` supplies an enclosing cover or vessel, `ج ب ي B002` collected water and its basin, and `ر س و B001` settling firm and staying fixed. After the flowing copper of 34:12, the catalog progresses through large receptacles to anchored cooking pots; 34:15 then names edible provision. The branches assign enclosure, collection, and anchoring successive roles. The packet supplies source, vessels, and food; I infer that controlled capture converts moving abundance into stable communal use. The catalog reads as material governance, not ornamental display.

2. **Gratitude as making a small input visibly productive.** `ش ك ر B002` supplies being sustained by little and showing its effect. The ayah says the truly grateful are few, while 34:16 later reduces two gardens to bitter growth and a little lote. The branch assigns gratitude a resilience role: manifesting benefit even under limited input. The packet supplies fewness and later scarcity; I infer that gratitude is tested not only by abundance but by how provision is made to show. `ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ... شُكْرًا` reads as productive use, not verbal thanks alone.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:16 corrected any triumphal reading of the great vessels: abundance depends on containment that can fail, and output can contract to `قَلِيلٍ`. This made gratitude in 34:13 the disciplined use that maintains benefit, not celebration of scale.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Responsive Media Turn Command Into Form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Favor and command become visible by making unlike media responsive: bodies return in chorus, metal yields to joining, wind obeys a schedule, molten matter flows, and built vessels hold their assigned form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Landscape, animal movement, transport, metallurgy, hidden labor, and monumental craft are coordinated as different material responses to directed agency.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Scale changes the status of household objects: dishes become catchments and pots become architecture. The output of hidden labor is materialized as capacity held stable.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kolu, canlı bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem olarak kurar. İyi ve kötü davranış örnekleri bu çekirdeğin ahlaki alanlara da uygulanabildiğini gösterir; ücret, görev, karşılıklı işlem veya özel adlar bu kola ait değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, bilinçli yapılan iş ve eylemle sınırlıdır; ücret, resmi görev, karşılıklı alışveriş ve nesne ya da beden parçası adları ayrı kollardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem yalın iş anlamı hem de belirli kalıplı kullanımlar vardır; tanım yalın çekirdeği verir, kalıplı örnekleri bu çekirdeğe bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Canlı bir yapanın bilerek gerçekleştirdiği iş veya eylemdir; iyi ya da kötü davranışları da kapsayabilir. Kendisi için çalışmak ya da işe yoğun biçimde girişmek bu çekirdeğin özel kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
İyi ve kötü davranışlar da bilinçli eylem alanı içinde yer alır.
Kişinin kendisi için çalışması veya işe dalması bu çekirdeğin özel bir görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı canlı bir yapanın bilinçli biçimde yaptığı iş veya eylem olarak toplar; bu kapsam iyi ve kötü davranış örneklerine de uygulanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, başkasını çalıştırma, birinden iş isteme ve görüş, söz, mızrak, yapı malzemesi veya zihin gibi şeyleri kullanma örneklerini aynı işe koşma alanında toplar. Bu, genel iş yapma değil, bir şeyi veya birini işlevde kullanma anlamıdır.
